props.css: #simple-flow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}#simple-flow li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 24px;gap:12px;align-items:center;min-width:0}#simple-flow .flow-node{display:grid;gap:6px;padding:16px 12px;border:1px solid var(--color-border-secondary);border-radius:8px;background:var(--color-background-secondary)}#simple-flow strong{font-weight:500}#simple-flow span{color:var(--color-text-secondary);font-size:13px}#simple-flow svg{width:24px;height:24px}#simple-flow path{fill:none;stroke:var(--color-text-primary);stroke-width:1.5}#simple-flow li:last-child svg{visibility:hidden}@media(max-width:480px){#simple-flow{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}#simple-flow li{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}#simple-flow svg{justify-self:center;transform:rotate(90deg)}#simple-flow li:last-child svg{display:none}}
